security_gate.scope: PyTorch torch.load weights_only=True malicious checkpoint memory corruption and possible code execution
absolute_controls: Treat .pth .pt .th .pkl checkpoint file contents as untrusted before parsing; no direct model load.
torch.hub.load imports GitHub code and may download external weights automatically; use read-only metadata APIs and pinned source instead.
Even patched weights_only=True is not a proof that an artifact or any downstream model code is safe.
Future authorized test should run only in isolated OS/container with network blocked, no user secrets mounts, and resource constraints.
Preserve original opaque artifact bytes and provenance first. Safe conversion requires explicit separate review and execution authorization.
